name: @frontguard/mcp
description: Pre-release Frontguard MCP server for querying a verified cloud API deployment. No default hosted endpoint is live.

env.name: FRONTGUARD_API_URL
env.description: Verified Frontguard API deployment URL. No default hosted endpoint is live.

tools.name: list_regressions
tools.description: Return the visual regressions Frontguard detected for a GitHub PR number, a run id, or `"latest"` (the newest run; in local-report mode, the report's run). Rows come worst first (regression and error before changed, then by `diffPercentage`), at most `limit` per page (default 25, max 200); pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` for more. Run fields (`runId`, `reportUrl`, PR, repo, commit) are top level. Each row carries a `diffId` for `inspect_diff_cluster_dom`, `get_suggested_fix` and `verify_css_patch`, plus a `clusterCount`.

tools.name: list_horizontal_overflow
tools.description: List horizontal overflow from a run (the newest run when `run_id` is omitted). A flagged row is a visible unclipped box past the right edge, with selector and pixels. Only flagged rows are returned unless `flagged_only` is false. Rows come largest element `overflowPx` first, at most `limit` per page (default 25, max 200); pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` for more. scrollWidth and innerWidth are recorded. This does not change the pixel result or the exit code.

tools.name: get_suggested_fix
tools.description: Return the AI-generated patch for a single diff (keyed by the `diffId` from `list_regressions`). Fixes exist only when the run had an `ai` provider and `generateFixes: true`; otherwise `fix` is null and `reason` says why.

tools.name: accept_baseline
tools.description: Record run-scoped whole-run approval after `confirm_all_regressions_reviewed: true`. Refused in local-report mode (local reports are read-only). Use the CLI or composite Action to update git baseline screenshots.

tools.name: recent_runs
tools.description: List the most recent runs the API key has access to. Optional `repo` and `branch` filters narrow the results.

tools.name: inspect_diff_cluster_dom
tools.description: Inspect a specific visual regression diff cluster, returning its bounding box, AI classification, suggested fix, and grounded DOM target selector.

tools.name: verify_css_patch
tools.description: Statically check a candidate CSS patch for a diff from `list_regressions` using a CSS parser: brace balance and declaration syntax (including nested `@media`/`@supports`), a deny list (`@import`, `url()`, `image-set()`, `expression()`, `-moz-binding`, `behavior`, and hiding rules like `display: none`, `visibility: hidden`, `opacity: 0`, `clip-path`, zero-scale `transform`, `content-visibility: hidden`), and whether `target_selector` matches a recorded selector. It renders nothing and cannot confirm a visual fix: `staticCheck: "pass"` comes with `rendered: false`, so apply the patch locally and re-run `frontguard run` to confirm the pixels.

tools.name: promote_baseline
tools.description: Record whole-run approval for an explicit `run_id` after `confirm_reviewed: true`, returning `screenshotsPromoted` from the Cloud API response. `routes` does not scope the approval: the call is refused unless every changed route in the run is included. Refused in local-report mode. A human updates git baseline files with `frontguard update-baselines --confirm-baselines`.
